response.sql: WITH project_ratios AS (SELECT p.arcregistry AS project_id, p.fundflux AS funding_source, SUM(s.boxx) / NULLIF(SUM(s.boxz), 0) AS ratio FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux), ranked AS (SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, ratio - AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY funding_source) AS excess FROM project_ratios) SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, excess FROM ranked WHERE excess > 0 ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST, project_id LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A missing or zero total for boxz makes the ratio unavailable; such projects are excluded from the average and cannot qualify as above it.
